model_generated_sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.tier = 'Marketplace' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM aster_orders o JOIN aster_bridge b ON b.buyer = o.buyer JOIN aster_account a ON a.acct = b.acct WHERE o.state = 'ok0'
